positions.pos: Your message is recorded as a ruling: the six faces correspond to the integral levels, so skilled play can show the level of complexity and development a player works at. Players are not told at the start; it emerges through play. The altitude claim stays bounded to one line or domain, with evidence, a time, an uncertainty and a way to correct it, and it never becomes a statement about the person's worth. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: Your words, 2026-10-22: "Not nothing these faces do correspond to the integral levels so they do show what level of complexity and level of development they are working with the players don't need to know this at the beginning but will emerge through skillful play". It meets the face-namespaces decision (forbidden inferences 2, 3 and 16), which bars an undisclosed altitude judgment. Source: bars-engine docs/the-work-dbt-extension.md (PR #427), section 1A.

positions.pos: Your message is recorded as a ruling: streaks are allowed as assessment data for a coach or teacher, showing where and under what context a run was not maintained. Players see no countdown, no guilt message and no penalty, and declared rest pauses a run. This flips the no-streak position in the inner-vessel and ttv passes. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: Your words, 2026-10-22: "We can allow streaks at this will be data for any coach or teacher that's using this as an assessment tool. But it's not coercive just emergent data of where and under what context streaks weren't maintained". Source: bars-engine docs/the-work-dbt-extension.md (PR #427), C1.

positions.pos: Your message is recorded as a ruling: no particular answer is more rewarding than another, and engagement is rewarded. Engagement means taking the step, and an answer, a pass and a not-now all count the same. Rewards never scale with length or intimacy. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: Your words, 2026-10-22: "No particular answer can be more rewarding than another but we do want to reward people for engaging". The pass rule keeps intimate disclosure from becoming progression currency (Quickstart). Source: bars-engine docs/the-work-dbt-extension.md (PR #427), C20.

positions.pos: Your message is recorded as a ruling: The Work and DBT are adapted, cited on a works-cited page, and made your own. Skills carry generic names with a lineage line and a note on what changed. Whether adaptation needs the rights holders' permission is a question for counsel. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: Your words, 2026-10-22: "My plan is to adapt the work and DBT. These will be in a work cited page and one of the main goals is to make these implementations my own". Source: bars-engine docs/the-work-dbt-extension.md (PR #427), section 8 and C10.

positions.pos: Player-facing and council text says shadow kinds (forgetting, distracting, dissociating, numbness) and never faces, because face belongs to the Six Faces namespace. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: Settled by the face-namespaces decision and the 2026-10-17 perceptual-shadow note. Source: bars-engine docs/the-work-dbt-extension.md (PR #427), C3.

positions.pos: A pause is not a skip. The daemon still holds the way, and Step back, Calm, Take it home and the room's rest by the door are the exits on every page. This holds in every tier. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: Your ruling of 2026-10-10 (no skip at a daemon) and the research note's visible, chosen, exitable test. Source: bars-engine docs/the-work-dbt-extension.md (PR #427), C4.

positions.pos: The Work is one skill branch built on the registry's T04 Belief Inquiry, and DBT skills are registry entries with the same fields. Each face's tunnel teaches first the part its lens fits, and any block forks to the branch from any tunnel. Inquiry starts after the daemon is heard, with its permission. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: LEVELS.md rules that branches belong to skills and tunnels dress them; the tool-scout rule says to start from what exists. The face table is the input to each tunnel's pass. Source: bars-engine docs/the-work-dbt-extension.md (PR #427), 3.2 to 3.4.

positions.pos: A thought is a line the player writes, attached to a creature or a daemon's voice. Lines stay on the device with Forget and Delete on each, as Big Mind's kept cards do. Syncing needs its own permission grant. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: Words stay on the page (a standing choice), and the privacy rules bind audience, purpose and duration. Source: bars-engine docs/the-work-dbt-extension.md (PR #427), 3.1 and C6.

positions.pos: A coach or teacher sees streak or assessment data only through a grant the player can see and stop. The player sees what is shared and with whom. For children a guardian is a further authority. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: The permission envelope binds audience, purpose, duration and revocation (Quickstart). Source: bars-engine docs/the-work-dbt-extension.md (PR #427), C19.

positions.pos: Wise Mind is the centre of the self; emotion mind is the Emotional Body daemon and reasonable mind is the Architect's tunnel. Big Mind keeps its name for its own cave. DBT's words are cited and never renamed. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: The Regent's term test: a source's word is cited, not renamed. Source: bars-engine docs/the-work-dbt-extension.md (PR #427), 3.3 and C13.

positions.pos: Every prompt in the Work and DBT branches has a template, so the whole loop plays with no model. Any AI reading of a player's lines is an optional proposal. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: The Portland community's allergy to AI and the ontology's rule that AI inference is a proposal only. Source: bars-engine docs/the-work-dbt-extension.md (PR #427), C17.

positions.pos: Adults and middle/high school come first. Children are a declared non-target for the first build, which ships with the child code paths absent, until a named clinician has read the child tier (tw-tier-gate). Mortal spirits and streak repair do not reach children before that. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: Five faces recommended A. Citations: the 2026-10-17 perceptual-shadow note (no children's version in scope), C2 and C14 of the design doc. Audience is reserved, so this is a stand-still position the owner can ratify or flip. Source: council/passes/6FACE_PASS_work-dbt1_2026-10-22.md

positions.pos: The harm gate fires on the player's own button or choice only. Nothing the player writes is read for them. The trusted-adult field exists empty and off until a guardian model and counsel have read it, and the cave never claims it catches harm. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: Five faces recommended A. Citations: standing rules 5, 12 and 15 (no free-text reading, a non-AI route, words stay on the page), C5 and C16 of the design doc. B and C are closed by the record. Source: council/passes/6FACE_PASS_work-dbt1_2026-10-22.md

positions.pos: A reading of a player's level is told once at first use, as a bounded claim (domain, evidence, time, uncertainty, correction path), with a way to contest it and to play without it. No reading goes to a coach before the player has been told. Every reward is the same whether the player accepts the reading or not. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: Five faces recommended A. Citations: the face-namespaces decision (forbidden inferences 2, 3 and 16), C18, and your ruling tw-ruling-levels that players need not know at the start. Source: council/passes/6FACE_PASS_work-dbt1_2026-10-22.md

positions.pos: No child or trauma-tier build ships without a named reader's written read of the Work and DBT branches, the harm gate and the tier wording. Until tw-clinician is answered, those tiers wait and the adult skills tier makes no treatment claim. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: Regent and Architect set the gate and the Diplomat, Shaman and Challenger agreed; the only open fact is whether a clinician exists (tw-clinician). Citations: C11, the inner-creatures sheet, standing rule 11. Source: council/passes/6FACE_PASS_work-dbt1_2026-10-22.md

positions.pos: A coach or teacher view passes one test before it ships: a player in a classroom can decline it without losing baseline reward or standing. Engagement reward and streak data are kept apart in what a coach sees, and consent is asked again at use. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: Challenger named streak data plus engagement rewards as a coercion path; Regent added that a consent record is not present willingness. Citations: tw-ruling-streaks, tw-ruling-reward, C19 and C20. Source: council/passes/6FACE_PASS_work-dbt1_2026-10-22.md

questions.q: Is there a named clinician who will read the Work and DBT branches, the harm gate and the child tier before any child or trauma-tier player sees a build? If not, those tiers wait. The council recommends A.
questions.why_you: Only you know who is available. The inner-creatures sheet lists a clinician read as pending and nobody has asked. All six faces weighed in (pass work-dbt 1). They agree the child and trauma tiers wait without a named reader (tw-tier-gate); only whether one exists, and who, is yours, and naming a person is reserved.

options.label: A. Yes, a named clinician reads them first (recommended)
options.c: Unblocks the child and trauma tiers.

options.label: B. Not yet, so those tiers wait
options.c: Scope stays on the adult skills-practice tier.

questions.q: Do you authorise paying counsel to read the adaptation of The Work and DBT before the first public build? The council recommends A.
questions.why_you: Money and anything that names a person are reserved, and whether adaptation needs the rights holders' permission is a legal question. All six faces weighed in (pass work-dbt 1): four said A, and the Architect said A as a read and not as permission. Generic names with a lineage line apply either way. Only the spend is yours, and money is reserved.
questions.not_before: Raised by work-dbt pass 1, 2026-10-22, after your ruling that the practices are adapted and cited.

options.label: A. Yes, before the first public build (recommended)
options.c: Costs a legal read and settles whether permission is needed.

options.label: B. Only if a rights holder objects
options.c: Ships sooner and carries the risk of a takedown or a rework.

options.label: C. Seek permission up front
options.c: Carries a licence cost and may allow the original names.
